title: Incident: checkout returning 503
description:
Run this the moment the checkout error rate crosses **5%**.

- Timebox: 15 minutes to mitigation
- Comms: update `#incidents` every 5 minutes
- **Do not deploy during the incident** — roll back instead

steps.title: Acknowledge the alert
steps.description: Claim the incident in the on-call tool, then say *"I'm on it"* in `#incidents` so nobody else starts debugging in parallel.

steps.title: Check the dashboards
steps.description:
Look at, in this order:

1. Error rate by endpoint
2. p99 latency
3. Pod restarts

If restarts are climbing, skip straight to **Roll back the last deploy**.

steps.title: List recent deploys
steps.description: The last hour of deploys is the first suspect. Anything shipped in the window gets rolled back before it gets debugged.

steps.title: Roll back the last deploy
steps.description: Roll back rather than forward: a fix ships tomorrow, a rollback ships now.
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'rolling back to the previous release...'
echo 'traffic shifting 100% -> 0% -> done'

steps.title: Post a status update
steps.description: One sentence of impact, one sentence of what you are trying. No speculation about causes.

steps.title: Open the postmortem
steps.description: Blameless, within 48 hours. Link the timeline and the deploy that triggered it.
